verdict.rationale: Nitrokey can be driven programmatically through an official Python SDK (nitrokey 0.4.2 on PyPI) and the documented nitropy CLI, which installs and runs keylessly. A community user also praises its dev tools, documentation and OpenSC/PKCS#11 integration, but another reports that some functions, such as attestation export, are not reachable via PKCS#11 and require a custom vendor shell. Missing for 10: documented API reference for the Python SDK, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), llms.txt/markdown docs, and complete coverage of device functions through standard interfaces.
